_comment: Analysis mapping (PHASE2_SPEC §2), kept as data. 'condition' says whether an analysis describes the existing land (observations of today's site) or the proposed design; every metric inherits it (decision S-8). docs/ANALYSES.md is generated from this file by scripts/gen_analyses_doc.py.

analyses.name: Climate baseline
analyses.measures: How hot the region is, and how often
analyses.method: ERA5 daily series via Open-Meteo (NASA POWER fallback); ETCCDI indices SU, TR and TX90p against 1961–1990; percentiles

analyses.name: Long-term climate trends
analyses.measures: Is the site's climate changing since 1981, how fast, and is the change statistically significant
analyses.method: NASA POWER monthly (MERRA-2, CERES/GEWEX SRB, GPCP-corrected rain), 1981 to the last complete year; deseasonalised yearly averages; Sen's slope with 95 % range; Mann-Kendall (Yue & Wang 2004) and least-squares t-test with effective sample size (Santer et al. 2000); significant only if both p < 0.05; Pettitt change point; validated in docs/VALIDATION_SPACEAPPS.md

analyses.name: Surrounding context
analyses.measures: What is mapped around the site

analyses.name: Land cover
analyses.measures: Which land-cover classes are on and around the site today
analyses.method: ESA WorldCover 2021 (v200) 10 m classes; share of each class on the site and in the surrounding ring
analyses.outputs: landcover_* metrics, land-cover layer, site-context statement

analyses.name: Urban form
analyses.measures: How the design uses the site: coverage, green, open and hard surface, spacing, setback, floor-area ratio
analyses.method: Exact polygon areas in local UTM; unions so overlaps count once

analyses.name: Vegetation
analyses.method: Sentinel-2 L2A NDVI, SCL mask, median composite; NDVI ≥ 0.2 = vegetation

analyses.name: Land surface temperature
analyses.measures: Which surfaces are hottest in the hot season today
analyses.method: Landsat C2 L2 surface temperature, QA mask, hot-season median; site position among surrounding 90 m blocks; optional (lst_downscale) random-forest downscaling to 30 m with residual correction
analyses.outputs: lst_* metrics, LST layers; lst_ds_* metrics and a 30 m layer when downscaling is on and accepted

analyses.name: Site trends inside the boundary
analyses.measures: Is the plot heating up, heating faster than its surroundings, or losing green cover since 1984; how fast; is it significant
analyses.method: Landsat 5/7/8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 via Planetary Computer: per year the clearest hot-season scenes (QA-masked, at least 60 % of the site clear); site and ring median surface temperature and site NDVI; yearly medians tested with Sen's slope, Yue & Wang Mann-Kendall and the Santer t-test (both p < 0.05); sensor check at 2013; per-pixel trends with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR q = 0.10
analyses.outputs: site_trend_* metrics, change maps (surface temperature, NDVI), significant-pixel outlines

analyses.name: Solar and shade
analyses.measures: Where the sun hits the ground, hour by hour, on a hot-season day
analyses.method: NOAA solar position; exact hourly shadow polygons 07–17 h

analyses.name: Planning compliance
analyses.measures: Whether the design meets verified planning rules

analyses.name: Hotspot detection
analyses.measures: Where the problems are on the drawing, how big and how severe
analyses.inputs: Outputs of A3, A6, A7 (A5 for site context)
analyses.method: Exact vector overlay of hard surface with hourly shadows (H1); distance to canopy and 15:00 sun (H3); rule geometry (H4); merging; §4.2 size × intensity severity. Site context H2 (Gi* at 90 m) comes from A5
analyses.outputs: Hotspot polygons with area, severity, metrics, causes

analyses.name: Heat-stress exposure
analyses.measures: Heat stress a person would feel in sun vs shade on a hot day
analyses.inputs: ERA5 hot-day conditions; sun/shade from A6
analyses.method: UTCI via pythermalcomfort; mean radiant temperature = air temperature + SolarCal ΔMRT (ASHRAE 55); composite ERA5 hot day 07–17 h solar
analyses.outputs: utci_* metrics (sun vs shade), sunlit area × very-strong hours

analyses.name: Intervention evaluation
analyses.measures: What each candidate intervention changes, measured
analyses.method: Apply to a copy of the design; partial re-run; difference

analyses.name: Cost estimation
analyses.measures: What an option costs, including maintenance
analyses.outputs: Cost range with sources, or 'price required'

analyses.name: Scenario comparison
analyses.measures: Which design performs better, at what cost
analyses.method: Same-data comparison; Pareto trade-off; ranking under user weights
analyses.outputs: Comparison, trade-off chart, choice under weights
